category: browser app builder with a coding agent

free_tier.stated: no free tier on Pro; USD 25 a month for 10M tokens a month with rollover, no daily token limit, Standard and Max agents; larger allowances are chosen on a Monthly tokens slider
free_tier.notes: a Pro 10M annual plan is USD 216 a year and a Pro 26M annual plan USD 540 a year; the Pro 100 monthly plan is USD 100 for 55M tokens a month

retention.stated: not applicable: a coding agent meters tokens, not stored bytes

egress.terms: Pro allows 1M web requests a month on hosted sites; a bandwidth figure for Pro was not read

interface_detail: a browser application at bolt.new; no public API, CLI or SDK. Pro adds MCP connectors and Supabase as a database provider inside the product, and a GitHub repository can be synced to a project; none drives the agent from outside
tooling: browser only: the user prompts the agent in the Bolt web app; no client, API, CLI or SDK exists to automate it
chaining: Pro adds custom domains, removal of Bolt branding, MCP connectors and Max, so a build can be hosted and served on the user's own domain from one account; code can be synced to GitHub and built on elsewhere. The tokens cannot be spent outside the Bolt web app

limits.value: Pro starts at 10M AI tokens a month for USD 25 a month; larger allowances are chosen on the Monthly tokens slider, for example 55M tokens a month at USD 100 a month
unused tokens roll over and stay valid for two months from the start of the billing cycle in which they were received
1M web requests a month for hosted sites

limits_note: Pro has no daily token limit; the monthly allocation, with two-month rollover, is the cap, and extra tokens can be reloaded only on the highest individual monthly Pro plan or any annual Pro plan
binding_note: the monthly token allocation of the chosen Pro tier, from 10M a month, bounds capacity; there is no daily limit

identity_cost.detail: a paid plan: Bolt accepts credit and debit cards for Pro and Teams plans and no other payment method; sign-up is Google, GitHub, or email, username and password. A phone or ID step is not described on the pages read

reliability_note: on cancellation all allocated tokens, rollover included, are lost when the billing cycle ends; subscriptions are non-refundable; Bolt Forge was included free with individual Pro plans only during a preview that ran from September 14 to October 14, 2026
confidence_note: prices and token allocations are quoted from the pricing page and billing help page read on 2026-11-02; the monthly price of tiers above Pro 100 and the Pro 50 allocation are not stated as a table on the pages read. The models behind Standard and Max are not published. Nothing was measured behind a sign-up.
